title: Safe in DllMain?
description:
Write `bool safeInDllMain(const std::string& action)` for a list of things a programmer might want to do in `DllMain`. Return `true` only for these, which are safe:

`"DisableThreadLibraryCalls"`, `"InitializeCriticalSection"`, `"TlsAlloc"`, `"set a variable"`, `"OutputDebugString"`.

Everything else, such as `"LoadLibrary"`, `"CreateThread and wait"`, `"open a socket"` or `"CoInitialize"`, returns `false`: when in doubt, do it later in an init function.
hints: Put the five safe actions in a `static const std::set<std::string>` and return whether the action is in it. Everything else is unsafe by default.
unitTests:
TEST("safe") { CHECK(safeInDllMain("DisableThreadLibraryCalls")); CHECK(safeInDllMain("TlsAlloc")); CHECK(safeInDllMain("set a variable")); CHECK(safeInDllMain("InitializeCriticalSection")); CHECK(safeInDllMain("OutputDebugString")); }
TEST("not safe") { CHECK(!safeInDllMain("LoadLibrary")); CHECK(!safeInDllMain("CreateThread and wait")); CHECK(!safeInDllMain("open a socket")); CHECK(!safeInDllMain("CoInitialize")); CHECK(!safeInDllMain("")); }
